original.target_description: Original primary paper unavailable; shared terminal acquisition miss records failed author-hosted PDFs and no OpenAlex OA location.

replication.target_description: Fayard et al. (2009), Study 1: ethical versus unethical autobiographical recall; choice of antiseptic wipe versus pencil, chi-square test among participants selecting exactly one gift.

n.quote: A total of 210 participants (117 female) with an average age of 19.13 (SD = 1.21) were used in final analyses.
n.sample_role: Participants in final analyses; unethical condition N = 104, ethical condition N = 106.
n.exclusions: 54 of 264 participants discarded because they declined both gifts or took one of each.

reported_success.quote: These data contradict Zhong and Liljenquist’s (2006) finding that increases in moral emotions such as disgust and guilt would lead to a greater desire for physical cleansing.
